pages.title: Skins
pages.text: Mega Chickens spawn rarely alongside ordinary chickens. Skin crates change their appearance without touching their behaviour.$(br2)Aviator, Big Brain, Creeper, Deep Dark, Dodo, Duck, Fox, Pink, Rambo, Reptar, Toxic, Valentines and Zombie crates all exist.
